technical.summary: Strong short-term bullish structure with golden cross and new highs, but extreme RSI/Stoch overbought conditions and weak volume create pullback risk; moderate swing entry with caution on momentum divergence.

fundamental.summary: AMP shows no fundamental conviction signals—zero insider activity, no institutional positioning, no government contracts, no lobbying spend, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 82 days present elevated risk.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; mixed retail sentiment (bearish 38.9% vs bullish 30.6%) with neutral fear/greed (46) provides no clear directional bias; insufficient data for conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with inverted yield curve, crisis-level VIX (341), imminent NFP event, and negative macro score (-7) create hostile environment for financials sector despite distant earnings.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross, new 20-day highs, price above 200-EMA, and Ichimoku cloud breakout create textbook short-term bullish structure with defined support at 252.27.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme RSI (82.62) and Stochastic (92.26) overbought conditions, weak volume confirmation (0.78 ratio), momentum divergence, inverted yield curve, crisis VIX, and zero fundamental conviction create high reversal risk in hostile macro environment.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows golden cross and new highs, but extreme RSI/Stoch overbought (82.62/92.26) with weak volume confirmation signals imminent pullback risk. decision.primary_risk: Extreme overbought momentum divergence combined with crisis-level VIX and inverted yield curve creates high probability of sharp reversal; existing AMP position and 76 Financials holdings amplify sector concentration risk.
decision.recommended_exit: If entry forced: ATR trail 1x with hard stop at 252.27 support; exit on RSI <50 or VIX spike >35.
